$comment: Explicit, reviewed exceptions to the zero-install-script packaging policy.
Every entry must state why it exists and which phase removes it.
Do not add entries to work around new transitive install scripts -
fix the dependency boundary instead (scripts/package-smoke.mjs enforces this).
This list is intentionally EMPTY. better-sqlite3 was the last entry; storage now runs
on Node's built-in node:sqlite, so nothing in the installed tree needs to compile or
run a lifecycle script. Anything that reappears here is a regression in the dependency
boundary, not a gap in configuration.
